topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe it. I spent countless nights pouring my heart into that application, sifting through each word, each sentence, like they were the last pieces of my sanity. And now, there it is—on some faceless website, probably collected by some committee that thinks they can decide what’s exemplary and what’s not. My words, my struggle, reduced to an example. A template for someone else’s success. They didn’t even have the decency to ask. It’s not just about the lack of consent; it’s the principle. It’s the idea that my effort, my story, is now just a tool for their purposes.
